meta: Concept site for Caliche Ridge Roofing, a made-up San Antonio roofer: free inspections, hail and storm repairs, metal roofs and full replacements. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Roofs built for Texas hail and heat.
hero.sub: Repairs, full replacements and storm inspections across Bexar County. You get a written estimate within 48 hours of your inspection.

services_title: Everything on top of your house.
services: Leaks, missing shingles, cracked flashing and worn vent boots, fixed before the next storm.
Tear-off to final nail sweep. Most homes are done in one to two days.
A photo report of every hit and soft spot, for you and your insurance adjuster.
Standing seam and exposed fastener panels that reflect summer heat.
Seamless gutters and guards sized to your roof, so water leaves the house.
Ridge vents and turbines that let the attic breathe and cut cooling bills.
steps: We go up, take photos of everything and walk you through what we found.
Line by line, within 48 hours. No pressure to sign on the spot.
One to two days on most homes. We magnet-sweep the yard for nails before we leave.

hero.alt: A dark wood-sided house with a steep standing-seam metal roof and skylights against a teal sky.

g1.alt: A corrugated metal roof with a turbine vent under a clear blue sky.

g2.alt: Close-up of dark metal roof shingles in neat overlapping rows, edges catching warm light.

area.title: San Antonio and the Hill Country edge.
area.note: We work within about 35 miles of downtown. Not sure if you're in range? Call and ask.

about.title: A local crew, not a storm chaser.
body: When hail hits San Antonio, trucks from three states over show up the next morning. Most are gone by the time a leak shows up in the fall.
We live here. The same project lead runs your job from the first inspection to the final walk-through, and picks up the phone if something comes up a year later.

promise.title: If a leak traces back to our work, we fix it.
promise.body: Every roof comes with the workmanship warranty in writing, and a copy of the manufacturer's warranty for the materials we install.

faq: Will my insurance cover hail damage?
It depends on your policy and the damage. We photograph every hit so your adjuster has what they need, and we can meet them on the roof.
How long does a new roof take?
Most homes take one to two days, plus time for cleanup and a final walk-through with you.
How much does a new roof cost?
It depends on size, pitch and material. The free inspection gets you a written number, so you're never guessing.
Yes. Standing seam and exposed fastener panels, in colors that keep the attic cooler.
Do I need to be home?
Only for the inspection walk-through and the final check. During the build we just need the driveway clear.

form.title: Book your free roof inspection.
form.note: Tell us where the house is and what's going on. We call back the same day to set a time.
